items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Frank did the packing. We had a room for packing. He put all the records. Orders were packed by him. I answered the phones.

ctx.x: I never talked about New Orleans with Sidney. I knew him in New York. New Orleans didn’t exist for me except on records—Bechet or King Oliver or any of the early... Jelly Roll Morton, who I adored! Whoo! I was crazy about the blues, and the lower, the better! I just LOVED all that music. I still have it, and I listen to it. I listen to some stuff today, it’s UCCH, sickening. Nothing! Well, you get older, you don’t get the same kicks you got. But when you’re young and you hear the real thing, what an impression…
Before we took a break, you were talking about how...and you just described how you were hands-on with Alfred and Blue Note, where you weren’t with Max and the Village Vanguard.
